error_patterns_fixed.pattern: TS2693: 'EnumName' only refers to a type, but is being used as a value
error_patterns_fixed.solution: Replace type-only imports with local enum definitions. Use 'import type' for interfaces and define enums locally as values.

error_patterns_fixed.pattern: TS2339: Property 'X' does not exist on type 'Y'
error_patterns_fixed.solution: Add missing enum values, interface properties, and methods to type definitions
error_patterns_fixed.example: Added INITIALIZING, RUNNING_CORE to ValidationState enum

error_patterns_fixed.pattern: TS2724: Module has no exported member 'X'. Did you mean 'Y'?
error_patterns_fixed.solution: Add missing type exports or create type aliases for backward compatibility

error_patterns_fixed.pattern: TS2554: Expected N arguments, but got M
error_patterns_fixed.solution: Fix method signatures to match actual implementation. Add typeof guards before optional method calls.

error_patterns_fixed.pattern: TS2564: Property 'X' has no initializer and is not definitely assigned
error_patterns_fixed.solution: Add optional chaining, typeof guards, or initialize properties in constructor
error_patterns_fixed.example: private engine?: LangGraphEngine; // Mark as optional

error_patterns_fixed.pattern: TS2322: Type 'X' is not assignable to type 'Y'
error_patterns_fixed.solution: Add type casts or expand interface definitions to include missing properties

lessons_learned: Type-only imports cannot be used as enum values - always define enums locally or import them as values
FSM pattern requires explicit enum definitions in each file to avoid circular dependencies
EventEmitter base class conflicts with cleanup() method - use destroy() as alternative
Optional chaining and typeof guards essential for defense industry quality code
Backward compatibility through type aliases prevents breaking changes
